name: com.rtmpe.sdk
description: Real-time multiplayer for Unity: rooms, networked objects, synchronised state and RPCs over an encrypted connection to the RTMPE service, with editor tooling that helps convert single-player projects.

samples.description: Connecting to the RTMPE service, handling connection events and disconnecting cleanly.
Connect, open a room and spawn the local player, using the prefab id from the generated prefab registry.
A room moving between two scenes, with RtmpeSceneLoader loading each scene and reporting readiness.
Two clients in one room through matchmaking, each moving its own avatar, with a credential component for player builds.
Room state that belongs to no player, kept on the world object: a shared board that late joiners receive and the next host keeps.
